title: Disinfection
description: Ozonation provides deep disinfection of premises and transport, destroying bacteria, viruses, fungi and spores without chemical residues. The gas penetrates all hard-to-reach areas.

public-transport.title: Public transport
public-transport.shortDesc: Disinfection of buses, trams and trolleybuses
public-transport.content:
Public transport is a high-risk environment for infection transmission. Ozonation allows quick and effective disinfection of bus, tram and trolleybus interiors between runs or at night.

Ozone disinfects everything passengers touch: handrails, seats, windows and walls. The gas penetrates all crevices and hard-to-reach areas for full interior treatment. Odors and mold growth are also suppressed.

Treatment: 20–40 minutes depending on interior volume. After treatment, ventilate for 20 minutes or use the vehicle's ventilation system to clear ozone.

Equipment can run from the vehicle's power (12V or 24V). No staff need to stay — turn on the generator and leave. No consumables reduce operating costs.

intro.text: Public transport is a high-risk environment for infection transmission. Thousands of passengers touch the same handrails, seats and buttons daily. Ozonation allows quick and effective disinfection of bus, tram and trolleybus interiors between runs or at night.
intro.text2: Unlike manual chemical disinfection, ozone penetrates all crevices and hard-to-reach areas, ensuring complete interior treatment. There are no chemical residues that could cause allergies to passengers.

highlight1.title: Advantage of ozone:
highlight1.text: gas penetrates crevices between seats, under upholstery, into the ventilation system — areas impossible to reach during manual cleaning. After treatment, the cabin is completely free from pathogens.

whatDisinfects.title: What ozone disinfects in transport
items: Handrails and railings — main passenger contact points
Seats and backrests — accumulate bacteria and odors
Windows and walls — dust and aerosol particles settle
Floor of the cabin — dirt and microorganisms accumulate
Ventilation system — spreads infections throughout the cabin
Driver's cabin — protects personnel from diseases

steps.title: Ozonator installation
steps.description: Place the ozonator in the passenger cabin at maximum height from the floor. Close all windows and doors.

steps.title: Start treatment
steps.description: Turn on the ozonator for 20-40 minutes depending on cabin volume. Leave the vehicle.

steps.title: Ozone exposure
steps.description: Ozone spreads throughout the cabin, penetrating all crevices and hard-to-reach areas. Destroys viruses, bacteria, mold.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: Open doors and windows, ventilate cabin for 20 minutes. Use vehicle ventilation system to accelerate.

organizationOptions.title: Treatment organization options
organizationOptions.text: Public transport disinfection can be organized in several ways depending on fleet size and operating schedule.

items.title: Treatment at depot
items.description: Centralized treatment of entire fleet at night with powerful mobile ozonators

items.title: Between runs
items.description: Express treatment at terminal stops with compact ozonators

items.title: Stationary installation
items.description: Wall-mounted ozonator in cabin, operating from vehicle power on timer

items.title: Mobile team
items.description: Portable ozonators for treating transport on the route

powerSupply.title: Power supply from vehicle electrical system
powerSupply.text: Ozonators can operate from vehicle electrical system, allowing treatment without external power connection.
powerSupply.highlight: Treatment requires no staff participation — just turn on the ozonator and leave. No consumables reduce operating costs.

items.title: No chemicals

safety.title: Safety requirements
items: Treatment only when cabin is empty
Driver and staff leave vehicle during treatment
After treatment — ventilate 20 minutes or operate ventilation system
Staff use respirator when entering immediately after treatment
safety.warning: When organizing treatment between runs, ensure ventilation time is included in schedule. Passengers must not enter cabin until ozone concentration drops to safe level.
